import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import io

# Load the dataset from the provided string
csv_data = """Person ID,Gender,Age,Occupation,Sleep Duration,Quality of Sleep,Physical Activity Level,Stress Level,BMI Category,Blood Pressure,Heart Rate,Daily Steps,Sleep Disorder
1,Male,27,Software Engineer,6.1,6,42,6,Overweight,126/83,77,4200,
2,Male,28,Doctor,6.2,6,60,8,Normal,125/80,75,10000,
3,Male,28,Doctor,6.2,6,60,8,Normal,125/80,75,10000,
4,Male,28,Sales Representative,5.9,4,30,8,Obese,140/90,85,3000,Sleep Apnea
5,Male,28,Sales Representative,5.9,4,30,8,Obese,140/90,85,3000,Sleep Apnea
"""

df = pd.read_csv(io.StringIO(csv_data))

# --- Data Preprocessing ---
# Fill missing 'Sleep Disorder' values for clearer plotting
df['Sleep Disorder'] = df['Sleep Disorder'].fillna('No Disorder')

# Split 'Blood Pressure' into two numeric columns for analysis
df[['Systolic BP', 'Diastolic BP']] = df['Blood Pressure'].str.split('/', expand=True).astype(int)

# --- Visualization ---
# Set a modern and clean theme for the plots
sns.set_theme(style="whitegrid", context="talk")

# Create a 2x2 subplot grid for a comprehensive dashboard view
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(20, 16))
fig.suptitle('Comprehensive Health and Sleep Analysis', fontsize=28, weight='bold', y=1.02)

# Plot 1: Relationship between Stress, Sleep Quality, and Occupation
sns.stripplot(ax=axes[0, 0], data=df, x='Stress Level', y='Quality of Sleep', hue='Occupation',
              size=15, jitter=0.15, palette='viridis', alpha=0.9, dodge=True)
axes[0, 0].set_title('Stress vs. Sleep Quality by Occupation', fontsize=18, weight='bold')
axes[0, 0].set_xlabel('Stress Level (1-10)', fontsize=14)
axes[0, 0].set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep (1-10)', fontsize=14)
axes[0, 0].legend(title='Occupation', loc='upper left', bbox_to_anchor=(1, 1))
axes[0, 0].grid(True, which='both', linestyle='--', linewidth=0.5)


# Plot 2: Impact of Physical Activity on Sleep Duration, colored by BMI
sns.scatterplot(ax=axes[0, 1], data=df, x='Physical Activity Level', y='Sleep Duration',
                hue='BMI Category', size='Daily Steps', sizes=(200, 600),
                palette='magma', style='Gender', alpha=0.8)
axes[0, 1].set_title('Physical Activity vs. Sleep Duration', fontsize=18, weight='bold')
axes[0, 1].set_xlabel('Physical Activity Level (min/day)', fontsize=14)
axes[0, 1].set_ylabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=14)
axes[0, 1].legend(title='Legend', loc='upper left', bbox_to_anchor=(1, 1))
axes[0, 1].grid(True, which='both', linestyle='--', linewidth=0.5)

# Plot 3: Blood Pressure distribution by Sleep Disorder status
sns.boxplot(ax=axes[1, 0], data=df, x='Sleep Disorder', y='Systolic BP', palette='coolwarm_r',
            boxprops=dict(alpha=.7))
sns.swarmplot(ax=axes[1, 0], data=df, x='Sleep Disorder', y='Systolic BP',
              color=".25", size=12, edgecolor='gray', linewidth=1)
axes[1, 0].set_title('Systolic Blood Pressure by Sleep Disorder', fontsize=18, weight='bold')
axes[1, 0].set_xlabel('Sleep Disorder Status', fontsize=14)
axes[1, 0].set_ylabel('Systolic BP (mmHg)', fontsize=14)
axes[1, 0].axhline(130, ls='--', color='red', label='High Blood Pressure (Stage 1)')
axes[1, 0].legend()

# Plot 4: Count of BMI Categories faceted by Sleep Disorder
sns.countplot(ax=axes[1, 1], data=df, x='BMI Category', hue='Sleep Disorder',
              palette='rocket', saturation=0.8, edgecolor='black')
axes[1, 1].set_title('BMI Category Distribution', fontsize=18, weight='bold')
axes[1, 1].set_xlabel('BMI Category', fontsize=14)
axes[1, 1].set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=14)
for p in axes[1, 1].patches:
    axes[1, 1].annotate(f'{int(p.get_height())}',
                        (p.get_x() + p.get_width() / 2., p.get_height()),
                        ha='center', va='center', xytext=(0, 10), textcoords='offset points',
                        fontsize=14, weight='bold')

# Adjust layout to prevent labels from overlapping and save the figure
plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0, 0.9, 1])
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
